Title: Azure Machine Learning announcements - Oct 2021 public preview capabilities

Body.Content:
You can now securely deploy a compute instance or compute cluster with No Public IP address, while simplifying network administration.

Hashicorp Terraform configuration templates allow you to deploy your Azure Machine Learning resources in a repeatable and predictable manner along with other resources across Azure and other clouds.

You can use AutoML for images to easily build computer vision models for scenarios like image classification, object detection and instance segmentation.

For more information visit:

  • Secure your Compute Instance with No Public IP
  • Secure your Compute Cluster with No Public IP
  • Manage Azure Machine Learning resources using Hashicorp Terraform
  • Generate models trained on image data with AutoML for image
